body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Kobe, Japan.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The world's biggest Naruto theme park is called Shinobi-zato, and it's located in a huge park named Nijigen No Mori, which translates to '2-D forest' in Japanese! Take a direct roundtrip bus adventure from Osaka or Kobe, and get in touch with your inner ninja on Awajishima island.
>
> This incredible anime-themed outdoor amusement park brings the most famous faces of Japanese manga, gaming and anime to life. Experience interactive outdoor activities that will put you into your own anime-inspired adventure, complete with theme music, maps to follow, and missions to complete!
>
> This ticket is the easiest and most convenient way to explore this unique Naruto theme park, with a direct bus from Osaka or Kobe to Nijigen No Mori Park, and includes entry to the Naruto Boruto Shinobi Village.
>
> It's an absolute must for fans of the Naruto or Boruto anime shows, and for everyone else, it's the perfect chance to become a fan!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €33.40. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 155 ratings and 104 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
